heard: You trusted in your beauty and played the whore Lavished your favors on every passerby Took garments and made gaudy shines for them Used my gold and silver to make male images Sent my oil and incense before these idols Sacrificed your sons and daughters to the fire Did not remember the days of your youth When you were naked and kicking in your blood Hear the word of the Lord regarding you I will gather all your lovers against you Strip you naked before them in the square They will tear down your mound and lofty shrines Stone you and cut you with their swords I will spend my wrath and my jealousy And I will be calm And no longer angry
